# Humanward Labs

> Humanward Labs is a human-centered design studio in Richmond, Virginia. Human-centered design in the age of AI: product design, experience design and design strategy. Our work has created over $1.3 billion in impact for brands including Circuit City, Microsoft, Allianz, Intersections and Capital One. Our principal created the #2 most-used GPT app.

## Services

- Product Design: interface and interaction design, prototypes tested with real people, and design systems that scale.
- Experience Design: journey maps and service blueprints that connect app, web, email and in-person touchpoints into one experience.
- Design Strategy: customer research and insight, opportunity mapping and priorities, and roadmaps tied to business outcomes.

## Approach: behavioral economics and decision-making

People don't decide the way spreadsheets assume. Humanward Labs applies behavioral economics to product and experience design: defaults, loss aversion, choice overload, anchoring, social proof and friction. Every engagement starts with a decision map: where people hesitate, what they weigh, and what moves them to act.

## Principles

Great experiences are useful, usable, desirable, findable, accessible, credible and valuable.
